parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test files: 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/AppConfigurationTests.swift' (package: AppServices) and 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceHTTPTests.swift' (package: Metadata). Although the context_flags do not set is_test=true, the file paths unambiguously place both type-alias-object declarations inside test targets (the 'Tests/' directory segments). Each test package independently defines a local MockURLProtocol alias scoped to its own test bundle, which is the canonical pattern for isolating URL-loading stubs per test suite. Merging them into a shared target would couple two otherwise independent test packages and risk polluting production dependency graphs.
